class.name: HEGoTerrain3DOutput
class.brief_description: Builds a Terrain3D node from the heightfield layers of a cooked HDA.
class.description: The [code]height[/code] layer drives the terrain itself; the optional [code]hegot3d_*[/code] layers add region masks, holes, per-texture weights and colour maps. Everything is driven by detail attributes on the height layer, so an HDA that does not set [code]hegot3d_spawn_terrain[/code] is skipped entirely.

method.name: output_phase
method.description: Name of the cook phase this handler is timed under.

method.name: should_handle
method.description: Whether the cook produced heightfield volumes, and Terrain3D is there to receive them.

method.name: handle
method.description: Fetches the cook's heightfield layers and builds the terrain.
